-- =====================================================================
-- JIESHUO STORE SERVER ADMIN - VERSION DEFINITIVA CORREGIDA V2
-- =====================================================================
-- CORRECCIONES V2 (además de las anteriores A,B,C,D,E):
--
-- [F] ERROR PRINCIPAL — upvalue nil en callbacks de thread/Runnable:
--     "attempt to call a nil value (upvalue 'showMainMenu')"
--     Causa: En AndroLua, los threads se ejecutan en un contexto Lua
--     aislado. Las variables declaradas como "local" en el scope
--     exterior NO son accesibles como upvalues dentro de
--     mainHandler.post(Runnable({run=function()...end})).
--     Solución: Todas las funciones de menú se declaran como GLOBALES
--     (sin "local"), y se eliminan las declaraciones anticipadas "local".
--     Los threads reciben showMainMenu y otras funciones como argumentos
--     explícitos donde sea necesario, o las referencian por nombre global.
--
-- [G] "local os" en streams — mismo error de V1 corregido aquí también.
-- [H] httpRequest sin lectura de body — corregido en V1, mantenido.
-- [I] setNegativeButton nil — corregido en V1, mantenido.
-- =====================================================================

require "import"
import "android.widget.*"
import "android.view.*"
import "android.content.*"
import "android.app.*"
import "android.app.AlertDialog"
import "android.view.WindowManager"
import "android.util.Base64"
import "android.os.Handler"
import "android.os.Looper"
import "java.io.File"
import "java.io.FileInputStream"
import "java.io.FileOutputStream"
import "java.lang.String"
import "java.lang.Byte"
import "java.lang.Runnable"
import "java.lang.reflect.Array"
import "java.net.URL"
import "java.net.URLEncoder"
import "java.net.HttpURLConnection"
import "java.io.BufferedReader"
import "java.io.InputStreamReader"
import "org.json.JSONObject"
import "org.json.JSONArray"

-- [F] ctx y mainHandler son globales para que los threads los accedan
ctx = activity or service
mainHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())

-- [F] Constantes globales accesibles desde cualquier hilo
REPO_USER = "andimoraleshernandez0-sudo"
REPO_NAME = "La-mejor-tienda.-"
CONFIG_DIR = "/sdcard/JieshuoStore/"
TOKEN_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "github_token.txt"
BRANCH_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "github_branch.txt"

-- ─── UTILITARIAS GLOBALES ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function readLocalFile(path)
  local f = File(path)
  if not f.exists() or f.isDirectory() then return nil end
  local len = f.length()
  if len == 0 then return "" end
  local fis = FileInputStream(f)
  local bytes = Array.newInstance(Byte.TYPE, len)
  fis.read(bytes)
  fis.close()
  return String(bytes, "UTF-8").toString()
end

function writeLocalFile(path, content)
  local f = File(path)
  if f.getParentFile() and not f.getParentFile().exists() then
    f.getParentFile().mkdirs()
  end
  local fos = FileOutputStream(f)
  fos.write(String(content or "").getBytes("UTF-8"))
  fos.close()
end

function showDialog(builder)
  local dialog = builder.create()
  if not activity then
    local window = dialog.getWindow()
    if window then
      window.setType(WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY)
    end
  end
  dialog.show()
  return dialog
end

function getSavedBranch()
  local f = File(BRANCH_FILE)
  if f.exists() then
    local content = readLocalFile(BRANCH_FILE)
    if content and #content:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") > 0 then
      return content:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    end
  end
  return "main"
end

-- [F] BRANCH global para que los threads lo lean directamente
BRANCH = getSavedBranch()

-- ─── MENU PRINCIPAL ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- [F] Sin "local" — función global accesible desde threads y Runnables

function showMainMenu()
  local options = {
    "Panel de Estadisticas y Estado del Repositorio",
    "Ver Historial de Commits / Actividad",
    "Configurar Rama Actual (Branch: " .. BRANCH .. ")",
    "Subir archivo local (Plugin)",
    "Ver / Eliminar archivos remotos (Repositorio)",
    "Editar Metadatos de Catalogos (Plugins / Sonidos)",
    "Gestionar Temas de Sonido (/storage/emulated/0/解说/Sonidos/)",
    "Enviar Notificacion a Clientes",
    "Ver / Eliminar Notificaciones",
    "Publicar Actualizacion de Tienda (version.json)",
    "Configurar Token de GitHub",
    "Cerrar Interfaz"
  }

  local builder = AlertDialog.Builder(ctx)
    .setTitle("Servidor Tienda - Administrador Supremo")
    .setItems(options, function(d, w)
      if w == 0 then
        showRepoStatsDialog()
      elseif w == 1 then
        showCommitHistoryDialog()
      elseif w == 2 then
        showBranchConfigDialog()
      elseif w == 3 then
        openFilePicker()
      elseif w == 4 then
        showRepoFilesMenu()
      elseif w == 5 then
        showCatalogManagerMenu()
      elseif w == 6 then
        showSoundManagerMenu()
      elseif w == 7 then
        showSendNotificationDialog()
      elseif w == 8 then
        showDeleteNotificationsDialog()
      elseif w == 9 then
        showUpdateVersionDialog()
      elseif w == 10 then
        local edit = EditText(ctx)
        edit.setText(readLocalFile(TOKEN_FILE) or "")
        local tokenBuilder = AlertDialog.Builder(ctx)
          .setTitle("Token de GitHub")
          .setView(edit)
          .setPositiveButton("Guardar", function()
            writeLocalFile(TOKEN_FILE, edit.getText().toString())
            Toast.makeText(ctx, "Token guardado correctamente", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            showMainMenu()
          end)
          .setNegativeButton("Volver", function() showMainMenu() end)
        showDialog(tokenBuilder)
      elseif w == 11 then
        if activity and activity.finish then activity.finish() end
      end
    end)
    -- [I] nil como listener puede causar NPE — usar función vacía
    .setNegativeButton("Cerrar", function() end)
  showDialog(builder)
end

-- ─── ESTADÍSTICAS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function showRepoStatsDialog()
  local rawToken = readLocalFile(TOKEN_FILE)
  local cleanToken = rawToken and rawToken:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
  Toast.makeText(ctx, "Consultando estadisticas en GitHub...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()

  thread(function(cleanToken, repoUser, repoName, ctx, mainHandler, fnMainMenu)
    require "import"
    import "java.net.URL"
    import "java.net.HttpURLConnection"
    import "java.io.BufferedReader"
    import "java.io.InputStreamReader"
    import "org.json.JSONObject"

    local urlStr = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName
    local conn = URL(urlStr).openConnection()
    conn.setRequestMethod("GET")
    conn.setConnectTimeout(10000)
    conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "JieshuoStoreServer/2.0")
    if cleanToken and #cleanToken > 0 then
      conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " .. cleanToken)
    end

    local code = conn.getResponseCode()
    local body = ""
    if code == 200 then
      local reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(conn.getInputStream(), "UTF-8"))
      local sb = {}
      local line = reader.readLine()
      while line ~= nil do table.insert(sb, line) line = reader.readLine() end
      reader.close()
      body = table.concat(sb, "\n")
    end

    -- [F] mainHandler, ctx, showMainMenu son globales — accesibles aquí
    mainHandler.post(Runnable({ run = function()
      import "android.app.AlertDialog"
      import "android.view.WindowManager"
      import "android.widget.Toast"
      if code == 200 then
        local ok, jsonObj = pcall(function() return JSONObject(body) end)
        if ok then
          local stars      = jsonObj.optInt("stargazers_count", 0)
          local forks      = jsonObj.optInt("forks_count", 0)
          local openIssues = jsonObj.optInt("open_issues_count", 0)
          local repoSize   = jsonObj.optInt("size", 0)
          local defBranch  = jsonObj.optString("default_branch", "main")
          local infoText =
            "Repositorio: " .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName .. "\n" ..
            "Estrellas: "    .. stars      .. "\n" ..
            "Forks: "        .. forks      .. "\n" ..
            "Issues: "       .. openIssues .. "\n" ..
            "Tamano: "       .. repoSize   .. " KB\n" ..
            "Rama defecto: " .. defBranch
          local b = AlertDialog.Builder(ctx)
            .setTitle("Estadisticas del Servidor")
            .setMessage(infoText)
            .setPositiveButton("Volver", function() fnMainMenu() end)
          local d = b.create()
          pcall(function()
            if not activity then
              d.getWindow().setType(WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY)
            end
          end)
          d.show()
        else
          Toast.makeText(ctx, "Error al procesar datos.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        end
      else
        Toast.makeText(ctx, "Error HTTP (" .. code .. ")", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
      end
    end}))
  end, cleanToken, REPO_USER, REPO_NAME, ctx, mainHandler, showMainMenu)
end

-- ─── HISTORIAL DE COMMITS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function showCommitHistoryDialog()
  local rawToken = readLocalFile(TOKEN_FILE)
  local cleanToken = rawToken and rawToken:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
  Toast.makeText(ctx, "Cargando historial...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()

  thread(function(cleanToken, repoUser, repoName, branch, ctx, mainHandler, fnMainMenu)
    require "import"
    import "java.net.URL"
    import "java.net.HttpURLConnection"
    import "java.io.BufferedReader"
    import "java.io.InputStreamReader"
    import "org.json.JSONArray"
    import "org.json.JSONObject"

    local urlStr = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName ..
                   "/commits?sha=" .. branch .. "&per_page=10"
    local conn = URL(urlStr).openConnection()
    conn.setRequestMethod("GET")
    conn.setConnectTimeout(10000)
    conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "JieshuoStoreServer/2.0")
    if cleanToken and #cleanToken > 0 then
      conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " .. cleanToken)
    end

    local code = conn.getResponseCode()
    local body = ""
    if code == 200 then
      local reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(conn.getInputStream(), "UTF-8"))
      local sb = {}
      local line = reader.readLine()
      while line ~= nil do table.insert(sb, line) line = reader.readLine() end
      reader.close()
      body = table.concat(sb, "\n")
    end

    mainHandler.post(Runnable({ run = function()
      import "android.app.AlertDialog"
      import "android.view.WindowManager"
      import "android.widget.Toast"
      if code == 200 then
        local ok, arr = pcall(function() return JSONArray(body) end)
        if ok and arr.length() > 0 then
          local commitMsgs = {}
          for i = 0, arr.length() - 1 do
            local ci   = arr.getJSONObject(i).getJSONObject("commit")
            local msg  = ci.optString("message", "Sin mensaje")
            local date = ci.getJSONObject("author").optString("date", "")
            table.insert(commitMsgs, "- " .. msg .. "\n  (" .. date .. ")")
          end
          local b = AlertDialog.Builder(ctx)
            .setTitle("Ultimos Commits (" .. #commitMsgs .. ")")
            .setItems(commitMsgs, nil)
            .setPositiveButton("Volver", function() fnMainMenu() end)
          local d = b.create()
          pcall(function()
            if not activity then
              d.getWindow().setType(WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY)
            end
          end)
          d.show()
        else
          Toast.makeText(ctx, "No hay commits recientes.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        end
      else
        Toast.makeText(ctx, "Error al obtener historial (" .. code .. ")", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
      end
    end}))
  end, cleanToken, REPO_USER, REPO_NAME, BRANCH, ctx, mainHandler, showMainMenu)
end

-- ─── CONFIGURAR RAMA ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function showBranchConfigDialog()
  local edit = EditText(ctx)
  edit.setText(BRANCH)
  local builder = AlertDialog.Builder(ctx)
    .setTitle("Configurar Rama de Trabajo")
    .setMessage("Introduce la rama (ej: main, master, dev):")
    .setView(edit)
    .setPositiveButton("Guardar", function()
      local newBranch = edit.getText().toString():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
      if #newBranch > 0 then
        BRANCH = newBranch
        writeLocalFile(BRANCH_FILE, BRANCH)
        Toast.makeText(ctx, "Rama actualizada a: " .. BRANCH, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
      else
        Toast.makeText(ctx, "La rama no puede estar vacia", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
      end
      showMainMenu()
    end)
    .setNegativeButton("Volver", function() showMainMenu() end)
  showDialog(builder)
end

-- ─── GESTOR DE CATÁLOGOS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function showCatalogManagerMenu()
  local options = {
    "Editar Catalogo de Plugins (catalog.json)",
    "Editar Catalogo de Temas de Sonido (sound_catalog.json)",
    "Volver al Menu Principal"
  }
  local builder = AlertDialog.Builder(ctx)
    .setTitle("Gestor de Metadatos de Catalogos")
    .setItems(options, function(d, w)
      if w == 0 then
        loadAndEditRemoteCatalog("catalog.json", "Plugins")
      elseif w == 1 then
        loadAndEditRemoteCatalog("sound_catalog.json", "Temas de Sonido")
      elseif w == 2 then
        showMainMenu()
      end
    end)
    .setNegativeButton("Volver", function() showMainMenu() end)
  showDialog(builder)
end

function loadAndEditRemoteCatalog(fileName, catalogTitle)
  local rawToken = readLocalFile(TOKEN_FILE)
  if not rawToken or #rawToken == 0 then
    Toast.makeText(ctx, "Configura el token primero", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    showMainMenu()
    return
  end
  local cleanToken = rawToken:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
  Toast.makeText(ctx, "Descargando " .. fileName .. "...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()

  thread(function(fileName, catalogTitle, cleanToken, repoUser, repoName, branch, ctx, mainHandler, fnMainMenu)
    require "import"
    import "java.net.URL"
    import "java.net.HttpURLConnection"
    import "java.io.BufferedReader"
    import "java.io.InputStreamReader"
    import "org.json.JSONObject"
    import "org.json.JSONArray"
    import "android.util.Base64"
    import "java.lang.String"

    local urlStr = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName ..
                   "/contents/" .. fileName .. "?t=" .. os.time()
    local conn = URL(urlStr).openConnection()
    conn.setRequestMethod("GET")
    conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " .. cleanToken)
    local code = conn.getResponseCode()
    local body = ""
    if code == 200 then
      local reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(conn.getInputStream(), "UTF-8"))
      local sb = {}
      local line = reader.readLine()
      while line ~= nil do table.insert(sb, line) line = reader.readLine() end
      reader.close()
      body = table.concat(sb, "\n")
    end

    -- fnMainMenu capturada como upvalue local antes del Runnable
    local _fnMain = fnMainMenu
    local _mainH  = mainHandler
    local _ctx    = ctx
    _mainH.post(Runnable({ run = function()
      import "android.app.AlertDialog"
      import "android.widget.*"
      import "android.view.WindowManager"
      if code == 200 then
        local parseOk, jsonResult = pcall(function()
          local obj  = JSONObject(body)
          local sha  = obj.optString("sha", "")
          local b64  = obj.optString("content", ""):gsub("%s+", "")
          local dec  = String(Base64.decode(b64, Base64.DEFAULT), "UTF-8").toString()
          return { sha = sha, arr = JSONArray(dec) }
        end)

        if not parseOk or not jsonResult.arr or jsonResult.arr.length() == 0 then
          Toast.makeText(ctx, "El catalogo esta vacio o no se pudo leer.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
          fnMainMenu()
          return
        end

        local itemsArray = jsonResult.arr
        local fileSha    = jsonResult.sha
        local itemNames  = {}
        for i = 0, itemsArray.length() - 1 do
          local item = itemsArray.getJSONObject(i)
          table.insert(itemNames,
            item.optString("name","Sin nombre") .. " [" .. item.optString("version","v1.0") .. "]")
        end

        local b = AlertDialog.Builder(ctx)
          .setTitle("Catalogo: " .. catalogTitle .. " (" .. itemsArray.length() .. ")")
          .setItems(itemNames, function(d, w)
            local targetObj = itemsArray.getJSONObject(w)
            local layout = LinearLayout(ctx)
            layout.setOrientation(1)
            layout.setPadding(30, 20, 30, 20)

            local edName = EditText(ctx)
            edName.setText(targetObj.optString("name",""))
            edName.setHint("Nombre")
            layout.addView(edName)

            local edDesc = EditText(ctx)
            edDesc.setText(targetObj.optString("description",""))
            edDesc.setHint("Descripcion")
            layout.addView(edDesc)

            local edAuth = EditText(ctx)
            edAuth.setText(targetObj.optString("author",""))
            edAuth.setHint("Autor")
            layout.addView(edAuth)

            local edVer = EditText(ctx)
            edVer.setText(targetObj.optString("version",""))
            edVer.setHint("Version")
            layout.addView(edVer)

            local editBuilder = AlertDialog.Builder(ctx)
              .setTitle("Editar Elemento")
              .setView(layout)
              .setPositiveButton("Guardar Cambios", function()
                targetObj.put("name",        edName.getText().toString())
                targetObj.put("description", edDesc.getText().toString())
                targetObj.put("author",      edAuth.getText().toString())
                targetObj.put("version",     edVer.getText().toString())

                Toast.makeText(ctx, "Subiendo cambios...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                thread(function(fName, fSha, arrObj, token, rUser, rName, br, ctx, mainHandler, fnMainMenu)
                  require "import"
                  import "java.net.URL"
                  import "java.net.HttpURLConnection"
                  import "java.lang.String"
                  import "android.util.Base64"
                  import "org.json.JSONObject"

                  local saveUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. rUser .. "/" .. rName ..
                                  "/contents/" .. fName
                  local conn = URL(saveUrl).openConnection()
                  conn.setDoOutput(true)
                  conn.setRequestMethod("PUT")
                  conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " .. token)
                  conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")

                  local putObj = JSONObject()
                  putObj.put("message", "Actualizar metadatos en " .. fName)
                  putObj.put("content", Base64.encodeToString(
                    String(arrObj.toString()).getBytes("UTF-8"), Base64.NO_WRAP))
                  putObj.put("branch", br)
                  if fSha and #fSha > 0 then putObj.put("sha", fSha) end

                  -- [G] Renombrado a putOS para no pisar el módulo os de Lua
                  local putOS = conn.getOutputStream()
                  putOS.write(String(putObj.toString()).getBytes("UTF-8"))
                  putOS.flush()
                  putOS.close()

                  local resCode = conn.getResponseCode()
                  mainHandler.post(Runnable({ run = function()
                    import "android.widget.Toast"
                    if resCode == 200 or resCode == 201 then
                      Toast.makeText(ctx, "Metadatos actualizados con exito", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    else
                      Toast.makeText(ctx, "Error al guardar (" .. resCode .. ")", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                    end
                    fnMainMenu()
                  end}))
                end, fileName, fileSha, itemsArray, cleanToken, repoUser, repoName, branch, _ctx, _mainH, _fnMain)
              end)
              .setNegativeButton("Cancelar", function() showCatalogManagerMenu() end)

            local editDialog = editBuilder.create()
            pcall(function()
              if not activity then
                editDialog.getWindow().setType(WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY)
              end
            end)
            editDialog.show()
          end)
          .setNegativeButton("Volver", function() showCatalogManagerMenu() end)

        local dialog = b.create()
        pcall(function()
          if not activity then
            dialog.getWindow().setType(WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY)
          end
        end)
        dialog.show()
      else
        Toast.makeText(ctx,
          "No se encontro " .. fileName .. " en el repositorio.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        fnMainMenu()
      end
    end}))
  end, fileName, catalogTitle, cleanToken, REPO_USER, REPO_NAME, BRANCH, ctx, mainHandler, showMainMenu)
end

-- ─── ARCHIVOS REMOTOS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function showRepoFilesMenu()
  local rawToken = readLocalFile(TOKEN_FILE)
  if not rawToken or #rawToken == 0 then
    Toast.makeText(ctx, "Configura el token primero", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    showMainMenu()
    return
  end
  local cleanToken = rawToken:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
  Toast.makeText(ctx, "Cargando archivos del repositorio...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()

  thread(function(cleanToken, repoUser, repoName, branch, ctx, mainHandler, fnMainMenu, fnRepoFiles)
    require "import"
    import "java.net.URL"
    import "java.net.HttpURLConnection"
    import "java.io.BufferedReader"
    import "java.io.InputStreamReader"
    import "org.json.JSONArray"
    import "org.json.JSONObject"

    local urlStr = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName ..
                   "/contents/?ref=" .. branch
    local conn = URL(urlStr).openConnection()
    conn.setRequestMethod("GET")
    conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " .. cleanToken)
    local code = conn.getResponseCode()
    local body = ""
    if code == 200 then
      local reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(conn.getInputStream(), "UTF-8"))
      local sb = {}
      local line = reader.readLine()
      while line ~= nil do table.insert(sb, line) line = reader.readLine() end
      reader.close()
      body = table.concat(sb, "\n")
    end

    mainHandler.post(Runnable({ run = function()
      import "android.app.AlertDialog"
      import "android.view.WindowManager"
      import "android.widget.Toast"
      if code == 200 then
        local ok, arr = pcall(function() return JSONArray(body) end)
        if ok and arr.length() > 0 then
          local names, paths, shas = {}, {}, {}
          for i = 0, arr.length() - 1 do
            local item = arr.getJSONObject(i)
            table.insert(names, "[" .. item.optString("type","file") .. "] " ..
                                       item.optString("name",""))
            table.insert(paths, item.optString("path",""))
            table.insert(shas,  item.optString("sha",""))
          end

          local builder = AlertDialog.Builder(ctx)
            .setTitle("Archivos en Repositorio (" .. #names .. ")")
            .setItems(names, function(d, w)
              local selPath = paths[w+1]
              local selSha  = shas[w+1]
              local delBuilder = AlertDialog.Builder(ctx)
                .setTitle("Opciones de Archivo")
                .setMessage("Deseas eliminar " .. selPath .. "?")
                .setPositiveButton("Eliminar del Repositorio", function()
                  Toast.makeText(ctx, "Eliminando...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                  thread(function(path, sha, token, rUser, rName, br, ctx, mainHandler, fnMainMenu, fnRepoFiles)
                    require "import"
                    import "java.net.URL"
                    import "java.net.HttpURLConnection"
                    import "org.json.JSONObject"
                    import "java.lang.String"

                    local delUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. rUser .. "/" .. rName ..
                                   "/contents/" .. path
                    local conn = URL(delUrl).openConnection()
                    conn.setDoOutput(true)
                    conn.setRequestMethod("DELETE")
                    conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " .. token)
                    conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")

                    local delObj = JSONObject()
                    delObj.put("message", "Eliminar " .. path)
                    delObj.put("sha", sha)
                    delObj.put("branch", br)

                    local delOS = conn.getOutputStream()
                    delOS.write(String(delObj.toString()).getBytes("UTF-8"))
                    delOS.flush()
                    delOS.close()

                    local resCode = conn.getResponseCode()
                    mainHandler.post(Runnable({ run = function()
                      import "android.widget.Toast"
                      if resCode == 200 or resCode == 204 then
                        Toast.makeText(ctx, "Archivo eliminado correctamente", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                      else
                        Toast.makeText(ctx, "Error al eliminar (" .. resCode .. ")", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                      end
                      fnMainMenu()
                    end}))
                  end, selPath, selSha, cleanToken, repoUser, repoName, branch, ctx, mainHandler, showMainMenu, showRepoFilesMenu)
                end)
                .setNegativeButton("Volver", function() fnRepoFiles() end)
              local delDialog = delBuilder.create()
              pcall(function()
                if not activity then
                  delDialog.getWindow().setType(WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY)
                end
              end)
              delDialog.show()
            end)
            .setNegativeButton("Volver", function() showMainMenu() end)
          local dialog = builder.create()

function doFolderSoundUploadAsync(dirPath, themeName, desc, author, token)
  Toast.makeText(ctx, "Subiendo tema de sonido completo...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()

  thread(function(dirPath, themeName, desc, author, token, repoUser, repoName, branch, ctx, mainHandler)
    require "import"
    import "android.widget.Toast"
    import "java.net.URL"
    import "java.net.URLEncoder"
    import "java.net.HttpURLConnection"
    import "java.io.File"
    import "java.io.FileInputStream"
    import "java.io.BufferedReader"
    import "java.io.InputStreamReader"
    import "java.lang.String"
    import "java.lang.Byte"
    import "java.lang.Runnable"
    import "java.lang.reflect.Array"
    import "android.util.Base64"
    import "org.json.JSONObject"
    import "org.json.JSONArray"

    local function urlEncode(str)
      if not str then return "" end
      local ok, res = pcall(function()
        return tostring(URLEncoder.encode(tostring(str), "UTF-8")):gsub("%+", "%%20")
      end)
      if ok then return res end
      return str
    end

    local function httpRequest(urlStr, method, tokenHeader, postData)
      local result = { code = -1, body = "" }
      pcall(function()
        local conn = URL(urlStr).openConnection()
        if postData then conn.setDoOutput(true) end
        conn.setRequestMethod(method)
        conn.setConnectTimeout(15000)
        conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "JieshuoStore/1.1")
        conn.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/vnd.github.v3+json")
        if tokenHeader and #tokenHeader > 0 then
          conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " .. tokenHeader)
        end
        if postData then
          conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
          -- [G] reqOS en vez de os para no pisar el módulo Lua os
          local reqOS = conn.getOutputStream()
          reqOS.write(String(postData).getBytes("UTF-8"))
          reqOS.flush()
          reqOS.close()
        end
        result.code = conn.getResponseCode()
        local is = (result.code >= 200 and result.code < 300)
                   and conn.getInputStream() or conn.getErrorStream()
        if is then
          local reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(is, "UTF-8"))
          local sb = {}
          local line = reader.readLine()
          while line ~= nil do table.insert(sb, line) line = reader.readLine() end
          reader.close()
          result.body = table.concat(sb, "\n")
        end
      end)
      return result
    end

    local dir = File(dirPath)
    if not dir.exists() or not dir.isDirectory() then return end
    local folderName = dir.getName()
    local files = dir.listFiles()
    if not files then return end
    local len = Array.getLength(files)
    if len == 0 then return end

    local uploadedCount = 0
    for i = 0, len - 1 do
      local f = files[i]
      if f and f.isFile() then
        local name = f.getName()
        local low  = name:lower()
        if low:find("%.mp3$") or low:find("%.wav$") or
           low:find("%.ogg$") or low:find("%.m4a$") then
          local fileLen = f.length()
          local fis = FileInputStream(f)
          local bytes = Array.newInstance(Byte.TYPE, fileLen)
          fis.read(bytes)
          fis.close()

          local b64Content = Base64.encodeToString(bytes, Base64.NO_WRAP)
          local remotePath = "sounds/" .. urlEncode(folderName) .. "/" .. urlEncode(name)
          local fileApiUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName ..
                             "/contents/" .. remotePath

          local getRes = httpRequest(fileApiUrl, "GET", token, nil)
          local sha = nil
          if getRes.code == 200 then
            pcall(function()
              local s = JSONObject(getRes.body).optString("sha","")
              if s and #s > 0 then sha = s end
            end)
          end

          local uploadObj = JSONObject()
          uploadObj.put("message", "Subir sonido " .. name .. " para tema " .. folderName)
          uploadObj.put("content", b64Content)
          uploadObj.put("branch", branch)
          if sha and #sha > 0 then uploadObj.put("sha", sha) end

          local putRes = httpRequest(fileApiUrl, "PUT", token, uploadObj.toString())
          if putRes.code == 200 or putRes.code == 201 then
            uploadedCount = uploadedCount + 1
          end
        end
      end
    end

    local catApiUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName ..
                      "/contents/sound_catalog.json?t=" .. os.time()
    local catGetRes = httpRequest(catApiUrl, "GET", token, nil)
    local catSha = nil
    local catalogArray = JSONArray()

    if catGetRes.code == 200 then
      pcall(function()
        local catObj = JSONObject(catGetRes.body)
        local s = catObj.optString("sha","")
        if s and #s > 0 then catSha = s end
        local b64 = catObj.optString("content",""):gsub("%s+","")
        if #b64 > 0 then
          catalogArray = JSONArray(String(Base64.decode(b64, Base64.DEFAULT), "UTF-8").toString())
        end
      end)
    end

    local folderUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName ..
                      "/" .. branch .. "/sounds/" .. urlEncode(folderName) .. "/"
    local updatedArray = JSONArray()
    local itemUpdated = false

    for i = 0, catalogArray.length() - 1 do
      local item = catalogArray.getJSONObject(i)
      if item.optString("id","") == folderName or
         item.optString("file_name","") == folderName then
        item.put("name", themeName)
        item.put("description", desc)
        item.put("author", author)
        item.put("folder_name", folderName)
        item.put("download_url", folderUrl)
        updatedArray.put(item)
        itemUpdated = true
      else
        updatedArray.put(item)
      end
    end

    if not itemUpdated then
      local newItem = JSONObject()
      newItem.put("id", folderName)
      newItem.put("name", themeName)
      newItem.put("description", desc)
      newItem.put("author", author)
      newItem.put("folder_name", folderName)
      newItem.put("download_url", folderUrl)
      updatedArray.put(newItem)
    end

    local saveCatUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName ..
                       "/contents/sound_catalog.json"
    local newCatObj = JSONObject()
    newCatObj.put("message", "Anadir tema de sonido completo " .. folderName)
    newCatObj.put("content", Base64.encodeToString(
      String(updatedArray.toString()).getBytes("UTF-8"), Base64.NO_WRAP))
    newCatObj.put("branch", branch)
    if catSha and #catSha > 0 then newCatObj.put("sha", catSha) end

    httpRequest(saveCatUrl, "PUT", token, newCatObj.toString())

    mainHandler.post(Runnable({ run = function()
      import "android.widget.Toast"
      Toast.makeText(ctx,
        "Tema de sonido subido con exito (" .. uploadedCount .. " audios subidos)",
        Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    end}))
  end, dirPath, themeName, desc, author, token, REPO_USER, REPO_NAME, BRANCH, ctx, mainHandler)
end

-- [B][G] doPluginUploadAsync — streams renombrados a putOS/saveOS
function doPluginUploadAsync(filePath, fileName, name, desc, author, version, token)
  Toast.makeText(ctx, "Subiendo plugin...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
  thread(function(filePath, fileName, name, desc, author, version, token, repoUser, repoName, branch, ctx, mainHandler)
    require "import"
    import "java.net.URL"
    import "java.net.URLEncoder"
    import "java.net.HttpURLConnection"
    import "java.io.File"
    import "java.io.FileInputStream"
    import "java.io.BufferedReader"
    import "java.io.InputStreamReader"
    import "java.lang.String"
    import "java.lang.Byte"
    import "java.lang.reflect.Array"
    import "java.lang.Runnable"
    import "android.util.Base64"
    import "org.json.JSONObject"
    import "org.json.JSONArray"

    local function urlEncode(str)
      if not str then return "" end
      local ok, res = pcall(function()
        return tostring(URLEncoder.encode(tostring(str), "UTF-8")):gsub("%+","%%20")
      end)
      if ok then return res end
      return str
    end

    local f = File(filePath)
    if not f.exists() then return end
    local len = f.length()
    local fis = FileInputStream(f)
    local bytes = Array.newInstance(Byte.TYPE, len)
    fis.read(bytes)
    fis.close()

    local b64Content = Base64.encodeToString(bytes, Base64.NO_WRAP)
    local remotePath = "plugins/" .. urlEncode(fileName)
    local fileApiUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName ..
                       "/contents/" .. remotePath

    local conn = URL(fileApiUrl).openConnection()
    conn.setRequestMethod("GET")
    conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " .. token)
    local getCode = conn.getResponseCode()
    local sha = nil
    if getCode == 200 then
      pcall(function()
        local reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(conn.getInputStream(), "UTF-8"))
        local sb = {}
        local line = reader.readLine()
        while line ~= nil do table.insert(sb, line) line = reader.readLine() end
        reader.close()
        local s = JSONObject(table.concat(sb,"\n")).optString("sha","")
        if s and #s > 0 then sha = s end
      end)
    end

    local uploadObj = JSONObject()
    uploadObj.put("message", "Subir plugin " .. fileName)
    uploadObj.put("content", b64Content)
    uploadObj.put("branch",  branch)
    if sha and #sha > 0 then uploadObj.put("sha", sha) end

    local putConn = URL(fileApiUrl).openConnection()
    putConn.setDoOutput(true)
    putConn.setRequestMethod("PUT")
    putConn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " .. token)
    putConn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
    -- [B][G] CORREGIDO: putOS en vez de os
    local putOS = putConn.getOutputStream()
    putOS.write(String(uploadObj.toString()).getBytes("UTF-8"))
    putOS.flush()
    putOS.close()
    local putCode = putConn.getResponseCode()

    -- os.time() funciona porque os NO fue sobreescrito
    local catApiUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName ..
                      "/contents/catalog.json?t=" .. os.time()
    local catConn = URL(catApiUrl).openConnection()
    catConn.setRequestMethod("GET")
    catConn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " .. token)
    local catSha = nil
    local catalogArray = JSONArray()

    if catConn.getResponseCode() == 200 then
      pcall(function()
        local reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(catConn.getInputStream(), "UTF-8"))
        local sb = {}
        local line = reader.readLine()
        while line ~= nil do table.insert(sb, line) line = reader.readLine() end
        reader.close()
        local catObj = JSONObject(table.concat(sb,"\n"))
        catSha = catObj.optString("sha","")
        local b64 = catObj.optString("content",""):gsub("%s+","")
        if #b64 > 0 then
          catalogArray = JSONArray(String(Base64.decode(b64, Base64.DEFAULT), "UTF-8").toString())
        end
      end)
    end

    local fileUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName ..
                    "/" .. branch .. "/" .. remotePath
    local newItem = JSONObject()
    newItem.put("name",         name)
    newItem.put("description",  desc)
    newItem.put("author",       author)
    newItem.put("version",      version)
    newItem.put("file_name",    fileName)
    newItem.put("download_url", fileUrl)
    catalogArray.put(newItem)

    local saveCatUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName ..
                       "/contents/catalog.json"
    local newCatObj = JSONObject()
    newCatObj.put("message", "Anadir plugin " .. fileName)
    newCatObj.put("content", Base64.encodeToString(
      String(catalogArray.toString()).getBytes("UTF-8"), Base64.NO_WRAP))
    newCatObj.put("branch", branch)
    if catSha and #catSha > 0 then newCatObj.put("sha", catSha) end

    local saveConn = URL(saveCatUrl).openConnection()
    saveConn.setDoOutput(true)
    saveConn.setRequestMethod("PUT")
    saveConn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " .. token)
    saveConn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
    -- [B][G] CORREGIDO: saveOS en vez de sos
    local saveOS = saveConn.getOutputStream()
    saveOS.write(String(newCatObj.toString()).getBytes("UTF-8"))
    saveOS.flush()
    saveOS.close()
    saveConn.getResponseCode()

    mainHandler.post(Runnable({ run = function()
      import "android.widget.Toast"
      if putCode == 200 or putCode == 201 then
        Toast.makeText(ctx,
          "Plugin subido y registrado en catalog.json con exito.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
      else
        Toast.makeText(ctx,
          "Error al subir plugin (" .. putCode .. ")", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
      end
    end}))
  end, filePath, fileName, name, desc, author, version, token, REPO_USER, REPO_NAME, BRANCH, ctx, mainHandler)
end

function sendNotificationAsync(title, messageText, token)
  Toast.makeText(ctx, "Enviando mensaje al repositorio...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
  thread(function(title, messageText, token, repoUser, repoName, branch, ctx, mainHandler)
    require "import"
    import "java.net.URL"
    import "java.net.HttpURLConnection"
    import "java.io.BufferedReader"
    import "java.io.InputStreamReader"
    import "org.json.JSONObject"
    import "org.json.JSONArray"
    import "android.util.Base64"
    import "java.lang.String"

    local function httpRequest(urlStr, method, tokenHeader, postData)
      local result = { code = -1, body = "" }
      pcall(function()
        local conn = URL(urlStr).openConnection()
        if postData then conn.setDoOutput(true) end
        conn.setRequestMethod(method)
        conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " .. tokenHeader)
        if postData then
          conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
          -- [G] reqOS en vez de os
          local reqOS = conn.getOutputStream()
          reqOS.write(String(postData).getBytes("UTF-8"))
          reqOS.flush()
          reqOS.close()
        end
        result.code = conn.getResponseCode()
        -- [C] CORREGIDO: leer el body que antes faltaba
        local is = (result.code >= 200 and result.code < 300)
                   and conn.getInputStream() or conn.getErrorStream()
        if is then
          local reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(is, "UTF-8"))
          local sb = {}
          local line = reader.readLine()
          while line ~= nil do table.insert(sb, line) line = reader.readLine() end
          reader.close()
          result.body = table.concat(sb, "\n")
        end
      end)
      return result
    end

    local msgApiUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName ..
                      "/contents/messages.json?t=" .. os.time()
    local getRes = httpRequest(msgApiUrl, "GET", token, nil)
    local fileSha = nil
    local messagesArray = JSONArray()

    if getRes.code == 200 then
      pcall(function()
        local obj = JSONObject(getRes.body)
        fileSha = obj.optString("sha","")
        local b64 = obj.optString("content",""):gsub("%s+","")
        if #b64 > 0 then
          messagesArray = JSONArray(String(Base64.decode(b64, Base64.DEFAULT), "UTF-8").toString())
        end
      end)
    end

    local newMsg = JSONObject()
    newMsg.put("id",    tostring(os.time()))
    newMsg.put("title", title)
    newMsg.put("text",  messageText)
    newMsg.put("date",  os.date("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M"))

    local updatedArray = JSONArray()
    updatedArray.put(newMsg)
    for i = 0, messagesArray.length() - 1 do
      updatedArray.put(messagesArray.getJSONObject(i))
    end

    local saveUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/" .. repoUser .. "/" .. repoName ..
                    "/contents/messages.json"
    local putObj = JSONObject()
    putObj.put("message", "Nueva notificacion: " .. title)
    putObj.put("content", Base64.encodeToString(
      String(updatedArray.toString()).getBytes("UTF-8"), Base64.NO_WRAP))
    putObj.put("branch", branch)
    if fileSha and #fileSha > 0 then putObj.put("sha", fileSha) end

    local putRes = httpRequest(saveUrl, "PUT", token, putObj.toString())

    mainHandler.post(Runnable({ run = function()
      import "android.widget.Toast"
      if putRes.code == 200 or putRes.code == 201 then
        Toast.makeText(ctx, "Notificacion enviada con exito", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
      else
        Toast.makeText(ctx,
          "Error al enviar notificacion (" .. putRes.code .. ")", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
      end
    end}))
  end, title, messageText, token, REPO_USER, REPO_NAME, BRANCH, ctx, mainHandler)
end
